source: Approved design .garura/project/issues/896/specs/design.md (approved by the product owner, 2026-10-30), How step 4

changes.old: - A second run finds the plan, the epic and the stories that exist, and makes no copies.
changes.new: - When the intent already has a plan file, the play stops at pre-flight, before it opens a change or writes anything, and points to /update-plan, which changes a plan that exists (#896).

changes.old: - Thin: what the play does when the slice changes after a plan exists is not set yet.
changes.new: - A slice that changes after the plan exists is handled by /update-plan, not by a second run of /shape-plan (#896).

changes.old: - Given a plan that exists, when the play runs again, then it makes no second epic and no second story for one feature.
changes.new: - Given a plan that exists, when the product owner runs /shape-plan, then the play stops before it opens a change or writes anything, and names /update-plan.

changes.old: - Goal: A second run finds the plan, the epic and the stories that exist, and makes no copies.
changes.new: - Goal: When the intent already has a plan, /shape-plan stops at pre-flight and points to /update-plan; it makes no second plan, epic or story.

changes.old: - Fails if: a second run makes a second epic for the slice or a second story for one feature.
changes.new: - Fails if: the intent already has a plan file and the run opens a change, reads the model or writes anything.
- GitHub #818 (open): the plan play. GitHub #896: /shape-plan stops when the intent already has a plan, and /update-plan changes it.
